name: Frascati (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Frascati (S.P.Q.T. and crossed branches on light blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Frascati, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Frascati arms — letters S.P.Q.T. and crossed branches on light blue, crowned, within branches
